title: DrillFlow document
description: A DrillFlow diagram document. Diagrams live in a flat map; hierarchy is expressed by node.childDiagramId / diagram.parentNodeId references, never by nesting the JSON. Prose reference: https://drillflow.de/en/format/

rootDiagramId.description: Key into `diagrams`. Every document has exactly one root diagram.

diagrams.description: Map of diagram id to diagram. Must contain the key named by rootDiagramId.

color.description: Any CSS colour. `url(...)` is refused: a colour lands in a `background` shorthand, so it is a way to make a shared document fetch a remote resource and report the viewer's IP back.

labelColor.description: The label's ink for the whole element. Without it a shape's label takes a readable ink from its fill (or the element colour in stroke mode) and an edge label follows the reader's theme. A labelRun's `color` wins over this.

labelRun.description: B42: a formatted stretch of the element's `label`. `start`/`end` are [start, end) offsets into that exact string, so every plain-text reader of `label` is unaffected. The array is a paint order — a later run wins per property. `align` is deliberately absent: alignment is a paragraph property of the whole element. A run that does not fit its label is cleaned up on load, and any label write that does not carry runs with it clears them.

color.description: Absolute ink for this stretch; unlike an element's colour it does not flip with the theme.

p.description: Stylus pressure; present only when real pressure was reported.

then.description: text and pin nodes cannot own a subflow.

id.description: Unique within its own diagram (not globally).

label.description: May be empty. \n is a line break.

x.description: Top-left corner, flow units. Y grows downward. OPTIONAL: omit x and y on every node of a diagram and DrillFlow lays that diagram out itself, the same way it lays out an imported Mermaid flowchart. Within one diagram it is all or nothing — positioning only some nodes is refused by the loader, a rule JSON Schema cannot express.

y.description: See x. Omit both together, or give both on every node of the diagram.

w.description: Omitted = per-type default (rect 140x60, circle/diamond 100x100, text 140x40, pin 12x12, draw 40x40, image 200x150).

childDiagramId.description: Key into the document's `diagrams`. That diagram must carry `parentNodeId` pointing back at this node.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise. Shape, text and image nodes only.

layerId.description: Must name a layer of the SAME diagram. Absent = implicit base sheet.

points.description: draw nodes only: ink points RELATIVE to the node's x/y.

src.description: image nodes only: inline data URI. Remote URLs are refused — they would report every viewer's IP back to whoever published the document.

portOf.description: Boundary port: the id of an edge in the PARENT diagram that this node stands for, so an arrow inside a sub-diagram can dock to what crosses its boundary. Created by the editor, not written by hand. Its label is rendered from the peer node on the parent level, so a stored label is only a fallback. A reader that does not know the field sees an ordinary labelled node, which is why it is one.

nodeId.description: A node in the SAME diagram as the edge. Edges never cross diagrams.

anchorDeg.description: Pins the endpoint to a fixed outline point: degrees clockwise from +X in the node's UNROTATED frame (0 right, 90 bottom, 180 left, 270 top). Omit for a floating endpoint, which is recomputed toward the other end — that is the recommended default.

anchorRel.description: Pins the endpoint INSIDE the node, at fractions of its width/height in the node's UNROTATED frame (centre = 0.5/0.5). Wins over anchorDeg. Meant for pointing at something inside an `image` — the editor writes it nowhere else. A reader that does not know the field draws the arrow to the node's edge instead.

handleId.description: Retired four-handle model. Still parsed from old documents, never rendered from. Do not write it.

edgeStyle.description: Per-edge override; absent follows the viewer's preference.

lineStyle.description: default 'solid'. Narrower than a node's lineStyle — no 'double'/'none'.

layerId.description: Must not be an EARLIER sheet than either endpoint's layer.

id.description: Should equal this diagram's key in the `diagrams` map.

title.description: A subflow's title mirrors its owning node's label.

parentNodeId.description: Present exactly on sub-diagrams: the id of the node that owns this diagram.

layers.description: Ordered transparency sheets, base-first, over an implicit base sheet (index -1). Absent = everything on the base.

showPorts.description: Does this sub-diagram show the parent level's inputs and outputs as boundary ports (see node.portOf)? Three-state: absent follows the reader's own preference, true/false is a deliberate choice for this sub-diagram. Meaningless on the root, which has no level above it.

documentStyle.description: The style a document was SHARED with: a snapshot of the sharer's own defaults, so a reader sees what the author saw even when no element was styled by hand. Not written into working documents.
